「………………」
中華飯店から出た時、時計は午後四時をさそうとしていた。
商店街に用事もなく、あとは家に帰るだけなのだが……。

pages.en:
“………………”

It is nearly four in the afternoon when I leave the Chinese restaurant.

I have no other business in the shopping district. All that remains is to return home, and yet…
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……”
It’s almost four o’clock when I get out of the restaurant.
I have no business in the shopping district, so all that’s left is to go home, but…

pages.ja:
「間桐臓硯……慎二と桜の祖父、か……」
何かイヤな予感がする。
このまままっすぐ家に帰る気になれず、日が暮れるまで、しなくてもいい回り道をした。

pages.en:
“Zouken Matou… Shinji and Sakura's grandfather…”

I have a terrible feeling about this.

Unable to bring myself to go straight home, I wander along needless detours until the sun sets.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Matou Zouken… Shinji and Sakura’s grandfather, huh?”
I have a bad feeling about this.
I don’t feel like going straight home, so I decide to take a detour.
